fato_historico: 2015: Forty-two people are killed and 33 go missing in the Kunduz hospital airstrike in Afghanistan.
energia_do_dia: Today, the cosmos invites you to embrace deep healing and resilience. Just as hope emerges even from the most profound shadows, you may find that your inner light has the power to soothe past hurts. It is a good time to release heavy burdens and focus on the strength found in communal empathy and tender self-compassion.
frase_do_dia: In every shadow, there is an hidden spark of profound hope and new beginning.
significado_numero: Represents the path toward collective healing and inner emotional stability.
conselho: Consider nurturing your spirit with kindness and trusting the process of gradual renewal.
